messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester in Wireless Communication, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

The knowledge base gave an answer, but the retrieved citations are mostly vault Wiki/source summaries with `raw_ref: null`, not page-level Raw excerpts. So the opportunity ranking below is based on current vault-grounded evidence returned by the RS knowledge tool, with the limitation that I cannot cite exact Raw page/slide IDs from this run.

## Strongest opportunities for Signaling / Non-signaling Testers in Wireless Communication

| Priority | Opportunity | Best-fit tester angle | Why it looks strong | Vault evidence |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Wi‑Fi 7 R&D signaling / real-world operation testing** | **CMX500** as multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester | Strong because the evidence explicitly links CMX500 to Wi‑Fi 7 R&D, signaling mode, cellular + non-cellular coexistence, MLO, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz, coexistence, and E2E testing. | Vault summary of *“Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi‑Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024”* says CMX500 is a **multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester** with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 functionality, intended to test wireless devices in a single-instrument setup across cellular and non-cellular latest-generation standards. It also says Wi‑Fi 7 R&D requires signaling mode under real-world conditions for RF TX/RX, and lists MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E tests. Citation returned: `wiki/concepts/Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing.md`, sections 1–2. |
| 2 | **Wi‑Fi 7 production non-signaling RF testing, with Wi‑Fi 8 early waveform exploration** | **CMP180** as production / R&D non-signaling tester | Strong because it maps directly to production test economics: non-signaling RF measurements are used to save time, and CMP180 is explicitly positioned for that purpose. The Wi‑Fi 8 / 480 MHz waveform point is an early-positioning opportunity, though not a formal standard claim. | Vault summary says in WLAN device production, **all RF measurements are executed in non-signaling mode to save time**, and **CMP180 is optimized for this purpose**. It supports Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz; includes two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO, and two CMP180s can scale to 4x4 MIMO access point testing. It also mentions loopback verification of a 480 MHz WLAN waveform as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / 802.11bn candidate, not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 spec. Citation returned: `wiki/concepts/Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing.md`, sections 4 and 6; source page `wiki/sources/Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`, section 3. |
| 3 | **5G NR / LTE device R&D callbox, pre-conformance, new bands and advanced RF verification** | **CMX500 Callbox** for signaling plus non-signaling R&D verification | Strong because this is broad, near-term, and product-aligned: new bands, RedCap, sensitivity, desense, pre-conformance, UL MIMO/CA, UL TX switching, multi-SIM and high throughput are all named use cases. | Vault summary of `CMX500_Callbox` says CMX500 Callbox is positioned to quickly establish DUT connection and perform **RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN/cellular desense, pre-conformance and non-signaling R&D verification**. Example use cases include **R&D verification of new bands, sensitivity testing, RedCap, desense testing, 3GPP pre-conformance, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, UL TX switching, multi-SIM testing, high E2E throughput testing, and non-signaling verification**. Citation returned: `wiki/concepts/CMX500 Callbox.md`, sections 1, 2, 5, 6. |
| 4 | **NTN / Direct-to-Cell / satellite communication validation** | **CMX500 / NTN signaling solutions** for NB‑NTN, NR‑NTN, LTE-DTC/NR-DTC, gateway and constellation scenarios | Strong because NTN is repeatedly evidenced as a customer-discovery and product-positioning area: NB‑NTN, NR‑NTN, Direct-to-Cell, LEO/MEO/GEO, service-link bands, satellite gateway integration, handover/beam switching, constellation workflows and future 6G NTN validation. | Vault summary of `cmx500_ntn_customer_questionnaire` says the questionnaire is for **Rohde & Schwarz NTN signaling solutions**, collecting customer requirements for NTN communication technology and tailoring a solution. It covers service offerings, live/simulated environments, RF/protocol/application testing, NB‑NTN, NR‑NTN, Direct-to-Cell/DTC/D2C, 3GPP Rel. 17/18/19 timelines, S/L/Ku/Ka bands, gateway integration, LEO/MEO/GEO/GSO, payload types, long-term LEO scenarios, QoS, mobility, handover/beam switching and constellation visualization/deployment in a CMX500 environment. Additional PR-related evidence says R&S and Gatehouse Satcom collaborate to accelerate validation methodologies for 5G NTN across GEO/MEO/LEO and lay foundation for future 6G NTN testing and validation. Citation returned: `wiki/entities/Christian Dobmeier.md`, section 2. |
| 5 | **Wireless certification labs / Global Market Access / PTCRB-GCF / regulatory pre-test support** | **CMX500 / CMW500 / CMP180** depending on signaling, RF, WLAN/cellular, and production/non-signaling needs | Strong because the evidence identifies market-access pressure and test-house needs: RF, protocol compatibility, interoperability, PTCRB/GCF, FCC/CE/NCC, GMA, satellite terminals, 6G, mmWave/MIMO, OTA/SAR/phased-array testing. This is an opportunity to sell into labs and ODMs preparing devices for certification, not necessarily a single formal conformance claim. | Vault summary of `無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx` says wireless certification labs test and verify wireless devices for regulatory, safety and performance standards; scope includes RF, EMC, safety and conformity certification; main tests include spectrum, output power, DFS, SAR, EMI/EMS, ESD, surge, protocol compatibility, interoperability, PTCRB/GCF certification; value includes preventing interference, accelerating market access, reducing recall/legal risk, and meeting Taiwan supply-chain needs for satellite terminals and 6G. It also lists Taiwan NCC flow, TAF labs, RF/EMC 3–4 weeks, and leading labs such as Sporton, SGS, TTC/ISL. Citation returned: `wiki/sources/無線通訊認證實驗室.md`, sections 1–3; `wiki/concepts/無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單.md`, sections 3 and 8. Limitation: this source is company-restricted, converted 2026-09-17, and lacks formal release date/version; it should be backed by official accreditation scope before making formal claims. |
| 6 | **Wi‑Fi / cellular interworking and voice continuity testing** | **CMX500** for single-box interworking, N3IWF, POLQA / voice quality | Strong as an application-specific extension of Wi‑Fi 7 and cellular convergence. It is narrower than opportunities 1–4 but useful for high-end devices that must handle WLAN offload and voice quality. | The MWC 2024 Wi‑Fi 7 source summary identifies CMX500 as adding Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality and also mentions **WLAN offloading, N3IWF, and POLQA voice quality measurement** in the PR context. Citation returned: `wiki/sources/Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`, section 3. |

## Bottom line

The strongest evidence-supported opportunities are:

1. **Wi‑Fi 7 R&D signaling testing with CMX500** — strongest explicit product/application fit.  
2. **Wi‑Fi 7 production non-signaling testing with CMP180** — strongest production-volume / time-saving story.  
3. **5G NR/LTE advanced R&D and pre-conformance callbox use cases with CMX500** — broadest cellular test coverage.  
4. **NTN / Direct-to-Cell signaling validation with CMX500** — strongest emerging-growth opportunity.  
5. **Wireless certification labs and GMA support** — strong channel/customer segment opportunity, but evidence needs formal accreditation documents before making precise lab-scope claims.

- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。

- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

- 來源稱認證必要性包括防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端與 6G 等需求。
- 來源列出台灣 [[NCC]] 認證流程：準備文件 / 樣品 / 電路圖 / 天線規格、提交 [[RCB]] 核驗機構初審、[[TAF]] 認可實驗室 RF / EMC 測試約 3–4 週、報告審查與證書核發，並稱證書有效期 5 年。
- 來源列出台灣領先認證實驗室：[[耕興]]、[[SGS]]、[[電信技術中心]] / [[ISL]]。
- 來源稱[[耕興]]具 30 MHz–325 GHz 全頻段測試能力、108 座測試場地、連續 10 年 FCC 最佳實驗室認證、10 米半電波暗室、OTA / SAR / [[相控陣列天線]]測試等能力。
- 來源簡述 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]、[[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]、Wi‑Fi / BLE 聯盟流程的差異。
- 來源將 LEO 衛星終端認證應用連到 Starlink / Kuiper user terminal RF validation、[[相控陣列天線]] beamforming 測試、mmWave / MIMO 高頻測試、台灣供應鏈 GMA，以及耕興等 [[RCB]] 提供 8–12 週 GMA 週期的說法。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

無線通訊認證實驗室 › 實體
- [[NCC]] / [[國家通訊傳播委員會]]：來源中的台灣 NCC 認證流程脈絡，需注意 [[NCC]] 既有頁面是縮寫碰撞頁。
- [[TAF]]：來源稱 TAF 認可實驗室執行 RF / EMC 測試。
- [[FCC]]：來源在認可機構、FCC 流程與耕興實驗室亮點中出現。
- [[RCB]]：來源列為台灣 NCC 流程中的核驗機構。
- [[耕興]] / SPORTON：來源列為台灣領先認證實驗室之一，並列出多項能力與宣稱。
- [[SGS]]：來源列為台灣領先認證實驗室之一，核心能力為 EMC / RF / 安規，特色為國際認可與 GMA 一站式。
- [[電信技術中心]] / TTC：來源以 `TTC / ISL` 列為台灣領先認證實驗室，核心能力為 RF 認證 / 測試，特色為台灣政府 6G 研究支援。
- [[ISL]]：與 TTC 同列，但來源未展開全名。
- [[Starlink]]、[[Project Kuiper]]：來源列為 LEO 衛星終端認證應用中的 user terminal RF 驗證對象。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：新聞稿發布者與測試解決方案供應商。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：frontmatter author 與 R&S registered trademark 所屬公司名。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：R&D single-box signaling tester；本來源新增 Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality、WLAN offloading、N3IWF 與 POLQA voice quality measurement 的 PR 語境。
- [[R&S CMP180]]：production / R&D non-signaling tester；本來源宣稱支援 Wi-Fi 6E、Wi-Fi 7、5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz、bandwidths up to 500 MHz，並展示 480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback。
- [[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]]：本來源的主題概念，區分 CMX500 R&D signaling 與 CMP180 production non-signaling 測試。
- [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]：本來源描述的 CMX500 single-box interworking / voice continuity 測試情境。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]：來源列出 320 MHz channel bandwidth、up to 16 spatial streams、4096 QAM、低延遲與 high throughput。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]]：來源稱 yet-to-be-defined，且 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion；CMP180 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate。
- [[MLO]]：Wi-Fi 7 key feature，使 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 變重要。
- [[N3IWF]]：Non-3GPP Interworking Function gateway；來源稱 newly integrated in R&S CMX500。
- [[POLQA]]：來源稱 R&S CMX500 integrated POLQA voice quality measurement function 可用於 Voice over WLAN applications。
- [[MWC 2024]]：展示場合。
- [[Christian Mokry]]：Press & media contact。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。
